input.summary: Make assignment mutual: Customer free to assign to affiliates/successors; IBM assignment requires our consent and never to a competitor; no IBM termination on our change of control.
input.comment: [Playbook] We need assignment to run both ways: our playbook position is that we may assign to an affiliate or successor without consent, IBM may not assign without our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a competitor of ours, and our change of control gives IBM no termination right. As drafted only we are restricted while IBM is free to assign to anyone.

ops.oldText: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
ops.newText: Customer may assign this Agreement without IBM's consent to an affiliate or to a successor organization by merger, consolidation, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets. IBM will not assign this Agreement without Customer's prior written consent, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and will not assign to a competitor of Customer.

ops.text: A change of control of Customer will not give IBM any right to terminate this Agreement.
